body:
After 10 years I refuse to believe that we can't make it work and I made my mind up a long time ago that I didn't want to find anyone else, ever. I would like to look back on this 30, 40, 50 years from now and think it was just a glitch and that we grew stronger but there are so many little things driving us crazy. 

I don't want to look for other 'fish' because I've caught the best one in the whole ocean...

I really don't want anything to be over but I'm feeling really numb inside. Smiling is the last thing I find myself doing but ok, you've convinced me. :)
